parsed.text: This packet contains two panels, p0 and p1, each giving 4x4 probability distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3. Candidate (commanded) records k0–k2 provide alternative conditional estimates: for example, some conditionals concentrate blue at [0,2] or the top‑left 2×2 instead of uniform, and some make n2 or n3 uniform. Copied prior records listed as origins are not new estimates; conditional command records are conditional forecasts/estimates, not executed events.
